target_customer: Employers hiring in healthcare, banking, high tech and manufacturing that want to hire for culture fit
problem: Companies hired candidates without measuring whether they fit team culture. Pomello mapped culture team by team through employee surveys and scored candidates.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for culture analytics integrated with recruiting

founders.name: Oliver Staehelin
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch describes a background in recruiting.

founders.name: Catherine Spence
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch describes a background in product management; she met Staehelin at Stanford Business School.

technical_complexity.rationale: Survey based culture profiles and a fit score built with academic research; standard software with data science work.

defensibility.rationale: Culture profiles accumulated from surveys, but there was little technical barrier and the data volume was small (70 profiles from 2,000 surveys in 2015).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: An assessment vendor, OutMatch, acquired Pomello in November 2017.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (2015) reported about 20 companies on the platform with First Republic Bank the first named customer; claims that culture fit hires perform better were unsupported by independent data.

branding.domain_note: Operated at pomello.com; a Trello Pomodoro app named Pomello also exists at pomelloapp.com.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found and the name collides with an unrelated productivity app.

outcome_analysis: Pomello was a small Stanford rooted team that built culture analytics for hiring, reached about 20 customers by 2015 and joined OutMatch in November 2017 with terms undisclosed. Public funding was tiny and unverified, so the exit looks like a small tuck in sale; the sources do not state why it sold.
notes: pomello.com did not resolve in this session. Aggregators show about $160K or $36K raised including Alchemist Accelerator and YC with a Seed II in January 2016, unverified, so no rounds recorded. Xian Ke is described by TechCrunch as a later team member; she is not listed on the YC page, so she is not recorded as a founder. Founding year 2012 per the OutMatch release (founded at Stanford), 2014 per YC. No dated competitor sources found; CB Insights lists later comparables only. The brand collision with the Pomello Trello app is noted from a SourceForge listing.
